owner_proof_sketch: Reuse Nat.choose_le_pow_div. Apply the exponential-series term bound Real.pow_div_factorial_le_exp at x=k to bound the reciprocal factorial by (exp(1)/k)^k, then multiply by n^k and combine the powers. No separate Stirling result is rederived.

Any overflowing intersection contains a (t+1)-element subset of S. Apply the existing uprob_exists_le to these subsets. For each fixed subset, split its coordinates from the unused coordinates with an explicit product equivalence and use OneWay.uprob_pi_forall; every selected coordinate equals the bucket label with probability 1/B. Count the subsets with the existing powerset-cardinality theorem.
Apply the published uprob_exists_le over all finite bucket labels, substitute bucket_tail for each label, and read the cardinality of Fin B.
Specialize bucket_tail to the full set, read Buckets.load through load_eq, and use the existing intersection and finite-universe cardinality lemmas.
Specialize some_bucket_tail to the full set and read the load, intersection and universe-cardinality equations through their published readers.
Use the existing nonnegativity of ProbComp.prob.
Union-bound the error events in each output's at most cLoc variables, then sum their indicator expectations using the existing probability readers.
On the event, the integer bad count is at least Γ+1. Apply the published Markov inequality and the locality expectation estimate, using W>0.

Read firstGood's failure condition. If no repetition succeeds, either the common capacity event holds, some repetition has Cond2 without Cond1, or all have Cond1. Apply the existing finite-event union bound through the uniform-draw bridge.

Use the three-event decomposition. Locality and Markov bound Cond1, conditionally on each fixed generator index. Independent noise repetitions then bound simultaneous Cond1. Bucket-tail bounds control Cond2 outside Cond1 and the common Cond3. The bucket count is polynomial; logarithmic growth and the resulting exponential bounds make their sum at most 2^(-κ), with no dependence on pp.
